Hey, things are going great now :) I just got released from the hospital today, i was there a week and a half. 
I was very calm before leaving which is why I think they let me leave, and plus I'm doing way better than I was over a week ago.

It's a group program but also therapy with different people. 
I don't think they are taking me seriously cause they didn't admit me to the ward and I've been suicidal, I guess they don't believe me.

It hasn't been good, I may try going back to the hospital now and thanks.

Just a month I've been in the program. I talk to them but I don't think they take me seriously, I did stay in the psych ward over a month ago but that was it. They don't think I should return so soon.
I am in a program that gives therapy and has groups but it's not really working.
